purpose: Teach: 時給/慣行/例会/結束/切り替える/同然/スキーム/富裕

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時給制、若い頃から私も使ってきた。
lines.en: I've worked with hourly systems since I was young.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Speaks from decades of experience without needing to underline it. Steady cadence. The weight of time behind each word but delivered lightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。慣行を守りつつ、進化させたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to honor our traditions while moving us forward.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Slight forward lean on 'honor.' Clear conviction underneath the courtesy. Neither rushing nor hesitating.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 例会では、結束、形だけにするな。
lines.en: In those meetings — don't let unity become just a formality.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Slight tap of warning on 'formality.' Not harsh, but unmissable. The tone of someone saying what actually matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 切り替える時、人を大切に。スキーム変更、急ぐな。
lines.en: When we make changes, people come first. Don't rush the transition.
lines.style: Steady resolve. Slight emphasis on 'first.' Measured pace — this is a commitment he's willing to speak aloud. Not defensive, not overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 同然の規模の競合、油断するな。富裕層、信頼で勝負だ。
lines.en: Don't underestimate rivals your own size. With wealth, trust is your only edge.
lines.style: Final wisdom, delivered with quiet authority. Slight pause before 'trust.' No urgency, but absolute clarity. The tone of someone closing a conversation that matters.
